integrity: The universal lower bound is proved algebraically from the degree filtration in Proposition 7.17. The included computation is only a regression check and is not evidence for the universal statement.
scientific_limitations: Restricted to smooth positive-dimensional complex Fano hypersurfaces in products of ordinary projective spaces. The result makes the intrinsic t1 bound exact; it does not claim necessity of every downstream sufficient automorphism-extension criterion.
title: Exact first-relation degree for anticanonical Fano hypersurfaces in products of projective spaces
